items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: just like Billy May in California sold his Lunceford style band, all his repertoire, and his name to somebody.

ctx.x: Yeah. Giardinelli has a mouthpiece that sells today, called the C. T. model. Giardinelli – G-i-a-r-d-i-n-e-l-l-i. Of course he sold his business and his name to somebody. I don’t even know if they’re – if he’s affiliated with them or not. I don’t think he is, because he sold it all, just like Billy May in California sold his Lunceford­ style band, all his repertoire, and his name to somebody. He can’t even use his own name. Those cats get uptight, want some bread, they’ll sell their mamas, I guess.
Tell me something about Elwood Buchanan.
